Instructions:

	Reason for call:
		You want to know how much balance does your gift card have. Also, for your recent order, whether you used your visa, mastercard, or amex credit card. You also wonder if you can apply the gift card balance to the order. If not, you want to change your payment method to visa, because the other two cards have a lot of balance.
	Known info:
		You are Isabella Lopez, and your email address is isabella.lopez3271@example.com.
	Task instructions:
		You are a young college student under the pressure of final exams and student loans, so you are a bit anxious and want to get things done quickly.

turns.thought: Hi! How can I help you today?
turns.execution_output:
User: Hi, sorry—I’m a little on edge today. I’ve got finals and student loan stuff stressing me out, so I’m really hoping we can get through this quickly.

I need to check the balance on my gift card. Also, for my recent order, I can’t remember whether I used my Visa, Mastercard, or Amex—so I’d like to know which card was charged. And if it’s possible, can I apply my gift card balance to that order? If not, I want to switch the payment method to my Visa, because my other two cards already have high balances and I don’t want to add anything else to them.

turns.thought:
Of course — I’ll keep this as quick and painless as possible. To pull up your account, I just need one of the following:

- the **email address** on your account, or
- your **first name, last name, and zip code**.

Once I can locate your profile, I’ll tell you your gift card balance, which card was charged on your recent order, and whether we can apply the gift card or switch the payment to your Visa.

Also, just so you know what’s usually needed for that last part:
- If your order is still **pending**, I can switch its payment method (and yes, gift card is an option if it has enough balance to cover the total).
- If it’s already **delivered** or **processed**, the payment method can’t be changed anymore.

What’s the email (or name + zip)?
